# armilla-defense

> Signed input lanes, watch-only socket gates and redundant-residue fault sensing.

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-defense && cd armilla-defense && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install -q cryptography && python3 tests/local_demo.py lanes` (expect: PASS).
Status: pre-alpha, under development — read STATUS.md before relying on a number.
Licence: PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0 OR PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 OR PolyForm Free Trial 1.0.0 (code); CC BY 4.0 (documents).
